title: Vendor Independence Mandate
summary: Mandate prohibiting critical infrastructure dependency on any single commercial vendor or proprietary platform.

sections.heading: Abstraction Requirement
sections.body: All integrations with external services must be behind provider-agnostic abstraction layers. No business logic may depend on a specific provider's SDK or API.

sections.heading: Compliance
sections.body: The Architecture Board reviews all new dependencies for vendor lock-in risk. Violations are treated as architectural debt requiring remediation within one release cycle.
